name: lifecenter-telegram-demo
description: SPEC-005 canal (A): Telegram → seudonimizar → lifecenter-demo-core (solo question) → responder; pegatinas (D12) y botón (D8). No guarda ejecuciones: el recorrido se ve en lifecenter-demo-core.

nodes.name: Llamar al núcleo
nodes.notes: SPEC-005: solo pasa question (texto seudonimizado) a lifecenter-demo-core; ningún identificador.

parameters.query: SELECT g.status, g.text_version, g.decided_at, handoff_awaiting($2) AS handoff_awaiting FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN consent_get($1) AS g ON true
SELECT g.status, g.text_version, g.decided_at FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN consent_accept($1, $2) AS g ON true
SELECT g.status, g.text_version, g.decided_at FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN consent_revoke($1) AS g ON true

WITH my AS (SELECT * FROM agenda_my_next($1)),
     t AS (SELECT CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN (SELECT my.type_code FROM my) ELSE nullif($2, '') END AS type_code)
SELECT (SELECT row_to_json(my) FROM my) AS my_next,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT t.type_code FROM t) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
         (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('starts_at', s.starts_at, 'ends_at', s.ends_at)
                                   ORDER BY s.starts_at), '[]'::json)
          FROM agenda_free_slots((SELECT t.type_code FROM t), $3::timestamptz, 3) s WHERE s.result = 'free') END AS slots,
       (SELECT (extract(epoch FROM st.change_min_lead) / 60)::int FROM agenda_settings st) AS change_min_minutes,
       reminder_state($1) AS has_reminder

WITH b AS (SELECT * FROM agenda_book($2, $3::timestamptz, $1))
SELECT b.result, b.reason, b.starts_at, b.ends_at,
       CASE WHEN b.result = 'taken' OR (b.result = 'invalid' AND b.reason NOT IN ('request_only', 'unknown_type'))
            THEN (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('starts_at', s.starts_at, 'ends_at', s.ends_at)
                                           ORDER BY s.starts_at), '[]'::json)
                  FROM agenda_free_slots($2, now(), 3) s WHERE s.result = 'free') END AS next_slots,
       CASE WHEN b.result = 'limit' THEN (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM agenda_my_next($1) m) END AS my_next
FROM b

WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM agenda_cancel($1, $2::timestamptz))
SELECT c.result, c.type_code, c.starts_at, c.ends_at,
       CASE WHEN c.result = 'not_found' THEN (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM agenda_my_next($1) m) END AS my_next,
       (SELECT (extract(epoch FROM st.change_min_lead) / 60)::int FROM agenda_settings st) AS change_min_minutes
FROM c

WITH m AS (SELECT * FROM agenda_move($1, $2::timestamptz, $3::timestamptz))
SELECT m.result, m.reason, m.type_code, m.old_starts_at, m.old_ends_at, m.starts_at, m.ends_at,
       CASE WHEN m.result IN ('taken', 'invalid')
            THEN (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('starts_at', s.starts_at, 'ends_at', s.ends_at)
                                           ORDER BY s.starts_at), '[]'::json)
                  FROM agenda_free_slots(m.type_code, now(), 3) s WHERE s.result = 'free') END AS next_slots,
       CASE WHEN m.result = 'not_found' THEN (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM agenda_my_next($1) x) END AS my_next,
       (SELECT (extract(epoch FROM st.change_min_lead) / 60)::int FROM agenda_settings st) AS change_min_minutes
FROM m

WITH f AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT reminder_forget($1) AS had_reminder, handoff_forget($2) AS had_handoff)
SELECT (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM agenda_my_next($1) m) AS my_next, f.had_reminder, f.had_handoff FROM f

WITH r AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE $4
           WHEN 'reminder_on'    THEN reminder_set($1, $2::timestamptz, $3)
           WHEN 'reminder_clear' THEN reminder_clear($1, $2::timestamptz)
           WHEN 'attend'         THEN reminder_confirm($1, $2::timestamptz)
         END AS result)
SELECT r.result,
       (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM agenda_my_next($1) m) AS my_next,
       reminder_state($1) AS has_reminder,
       (SELECT (extract(epoch FROM st.change_min_lead) / 60)::int FROM agenda_settings st) AS change_min_minutes
FROM r
SELECT p.id, p.code, p.reason, reception_chat_id() AS group_chat_id FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN handoff_pending($1) AS p ON true
SELECT r.code, r.chat_id FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN handoff_reply($1::bigint) AS r ON true
